## About

Daily Deep Think is a technology blog run by ByF, focused on three areas:

**AI & Engineering**: LLM internals (tokens, vectors, Transformers), prompt engineering, GPU training, RAG systems, AI agents, and the MCP protocol — systematic tutorials and source-code deep dives from theory to practice.

**Current Affairs**: In-depth readings of The Economist, The Wall Street Journal and other international publications, analyzing geopolitics, US-China tech competition, economic trends and social change.

**Deep Thinking**: Essays on the philosophy of engineering, team management, the meaning of life, and the uncertainty of AI.

Built with Hugo and the DoIt theme, hosted on GitHub Pages.
